instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: “Oh boy! Today is my lucky day!” thinks Rainbow, the dog, while chewing on his bone. “The butcher is my best friend. I love that human, yes I do!” Rainbow is very excited that the butcher gave him an extra bone.

instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Rainbow is excited to lay in his bed and chew his bone for hours. He walks his favourite way home, across the little pond where he likes to swim.

He steps onto the bridge and looks down into the water.
atoms.sound: ssml: Rainbow is excited to lay in his bed and chew his bone for hours. He walks his favourite way home, across the little pond where he likes to swim. <break time='600ms'/>He steps onto the bridge and looks down into the water.

atoms.text: “What!” barks Rainbow. “How has this other dog got a bone? And it looks even bigger than mine! I want his bone!” Rainbow drops his own bone and jumps into the water to steal the other dog’s bone.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m1'> “What!”</voice> <break time='600ms'/>barks Rainbow. <voice voice='m1'>“How has this other dog got a bone? And it looks even bigger than mine! I want his bone!” </voice>Rainbow drops his own bone and jumps into the water to steal the other dog’s bone.

atoms.a: Why did Rainbow jump into the water?
How would you describe the way Rainbow is feeling towards the other dog?
What do you think Rainbow will try and do next?

instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Only after Rainbow is in the water, does he realise the other dog is himself! The water made the reflection seem larger.

And now, Rainbow cannot find the bone that he dropped. Rainbow lets out a frustrated howl. He is tired from swimming and searching and has also lost his bone.

What do you think the lesson or moral of this story is?
b: ++don’t be greedy and appreciate what you have.
Always try to find the next best thing.
